name: Snackbar
hint: Tap Delete: the snackbar rises out of the tab bar like a drop. Tap Undo before its ring runs out, or swipe it away.
description: Snackbar for React Native with an action and a timeout, shown in a photo library with a floating tab bar. Each snackbar is a glass pill that grows out of the tab bar's top edge: it rises narrow, a liquid neck pinches off behind it, then it spreads and settles just above the bar, clear of the home indicator; when it times out it is drawn back into the bar. Delete shows Undo with a thin ring that depletes on the UI thread, and Undo really restores the photo into the grid with a layout animation. Swipe the snackbar down into the bar or flick it sideways (it rubber-bands upward and springs back on a short drag); a new snackbar pushes the old one behind it in a stack of two, and a finger resting on it pauses the clock. Neutral, success and error tones, with an error that offers Retry and a close button. Messages are announced through a polite live region; Reduce Motion swaps the emerge for a fade and short slide.
intents: toast notification above the tab bar
react native snackbar with swipe to dismiss
usage: Use for brief, low-priority feedback about something that just happened, optionally with one action (Undo, Retry). Keep the message to a few words and never put the only path to an action in a snackbar: it disappears. For errors that block the person, use an alert or inline message instead.
